title: Point agents at the command, not the 21 KB reference doc
lead:
`slicer ai instructions` is a right-sized ~1 K-token onboarding; `docs/agents.md` is
~5 K tokens and is for humans. The risk is an agent pulling the whole reference doc
into context. Make the repo's AGENTS.md and getting-started point agents at the
command as the canonical onboarding, and consider `ai instructions --brief` (just the
loop and exit codes) for the leanest start. The reference doc stays for people.
